Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText: BEGIN :CHECKS.CURRENT_KEY := :PIECES.LOAD_REFERENCE || :PIECES.PIECE_CODE; IF :CHECKS.DUPLICATE_COUNT > 1 THEN MESSAGE('This record already exists'); MESSAGE('This record already exists'); RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; END IF; END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMPARE_KEY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText: FUNCTION COMPARE_KEY(val1 VARCHAR2, val2 VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS answer NUMBER := 0; BEGIN IF val1 = val2 THEN answer := 1; END IF; RETURN(answer); END;
